title: Baked cod with tomatoes, olives and white beans
steps: Halve the tomatoes, cut the onion into wedges and slice the garlic, mix with the beans, olives, oil, oregano and salt in a baking dish and bake for 10 minutes.
Season the fish, lay it on the vegetables and cook for 12–15 minutes until it flakes easily.
Drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with parsley.
